vendor_name.description: The name of the vendor or organization providing this action.

vendor_url.description: The URL of the vendor's website.

action_id.description: The unique identifier for the PolicyKit action, typically following the org.<reverse_domain>.pkexec.<name> convention.

action_description.default: Run my service as another user
action_description.description: A short description of what the action does, used in UI dialogs.

auth_message.default: Authentication is required to run my service as another user
auth_message.description: The message displayed to the user during the authentication prompt.

icon_name.description: The GTK icon name to display in the authentication dialog.

defaults_allow_any.description: Default authorization for 'any' user (logged in or not). Must be one of: auth_self, auth_admin, yes, no.

defaults_allow_inactive.description: Default authorization for 'inactive' users (logged in but not on the active seat). Must be one of: auth_self, auth_admin, yes, no.

defaults_allow_active.description: Default authorization for 'active' users. Must be one of: auth_self, auth_admin, yes, no, auth_self_keep, auth_admin_keep.

program_path.description: The fully qualified path to the program that pkexec will execute, bound via the exec.path annotation.

argv1_annotation.description: Optional: The first argument that must be passed to the program to match this action. If empty, this annotation is omitted.
